reproducingTests: npm/scripts/__tests__/ingest-quarantine.test.js::checkout: the repo's agents/skills wins over a stale staged npm/agents copy
npm/scripts/__tests__/ingest-quarantine.test.js::#1589: an over-long issue is cut like a reason: tag
npm/scripts/__tests__/ingest-quarantine.test.js::#1589: a blank issue gets no quarantine:<issue> tag
npm/scripts/__tests__/ingest-quarantine.test.js::#1589: a numeric issue in a hand-edited ledger is still tagged
assumptions: A checkout is detected by a .git entry (dir or worktree file) in the parent of the npm package root; a published install's parent (node_modules) never has one.
The quarantine:<issue> value follows the full reason: rule (whitespace collapsed, redacted, cut to 100), not only the length cap.

Touched npm/ files keep their existing (non-prettier) style; reformatting them would add ~105 LOC of churn to npm/src/reporters/ingest against its 1800 maxLoc. npm/ is outside the ts format:check gate.

tagText lives in describe.ts beside the reason: tags and reaches quarantine.ts through a one-line re-export in payload.ts (an edge quarantine.ts already has): a direct describe.ts import raised a check-arch coupling violation on quarantine.ts, and defining it in payload.ts pushed that file past the 300-line perf threshold.
